### Kohl's Continues Partnership with Boys & Girls Clubs of America with $1.5 Million Donation to Support Youth Mental Health and Wellness Nationwide


10/09/2026


- [Download (opens in new window)](https://s204.q4cdn.com/271435555/files/doc_news/Kohls-Continues-Partnership-with-Boys--Girls-Clubs-of-America-with-1-5-Million-Donation-to-Support-Youth-Mental-Health-and-Wellness-N-LHPD8.pdf)


*Funding supports 4,700 Clubs across the country, including program improvements* *and trauma-informed care initiatives*


MENOMONEE FALLS, Wis.--(BUSINESS WIRE)--


In honor of World Mental Health Day on October 10, Kohl’s (NYSE: KSS) today announced a $1.5 million commitment to continue its national partnership with Boys & Girls Clubs of America. The funding will expand trauma-informed care training across local Clubs nationwide, helping Club professionals create healthy, supportive spaces where young people can build resilience and thrive. Through this next chapter of support, Boys & Girls Clubs of America will equip more staff and Club leaders with specialized training to address youth emotional well-being, manage stress and foster positive development.


“Supporting kids and families is central to our commitment at Kohl’s, because we know that feeling safe and supported is foundational to a child’s success,” said Jennie Kent, Kohl’s chief legal and corporate affairs officer. “We are proud to partner with Boys & Girls Clubs of America to invest in the emotional well-being of young people nationwide, equipping staff with the tools to foster resilience and help kids navigate today's challenges with confidence.”


**Meeting the Growing Need for Youth Well-Being**


Creating safe spaces offers crucial support for young people navigating daily challenges.[CDC data](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.cdc.gov%2Fhealthy-youth%2Fmental-health%2Fmental-health-numbers.html&esheet=54616614&newsitemid=20261009871668&lan=en-US&anchor=CDC+data&index=1&md5=1ff776052938aa8346513dde76d28ad7) shows that more than 40% of young people deal with persistent sadness or stress, creating a critical need for positive youth environments. Boys & Girls Clubs serve as trusted safe spaces, with[91% of Club youth](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=http%3A%2F%2Fbgca.org%2Fabout-us%2Fyouth-right-now-2026%2F&esheet=54616614&newsitemid=20261009871668&lan=en-US&anchor=91%25+of+Club+youth&index=2&md5=1edf9bf4314c68e417c98c04f7b5eb80) reporting they have an adult at their Club to talk to about their problems. Through Kohl’s support, Boys & Girls Clubs of America is expanding its trauma-informed curriculum across the country, following recent regional sessions where 100% of participating Clubs felt better prepared to support their youth.


“Trauma-informed Boys & Girls Clubs create safer, relationship-centered environments where young people feel seen, heard, and valued,” says Kate Endries, National Director of Trauma-Informed Practice for the Boys & Girls Clubs of America. “Through Kohl’s support, Clubs nationwide are strengthening staff practices, promoting well-being, and creating conditions for youth to thrive.”


**A Long-Term Commitment to Shaping Brighter Futures**


Building on an eight-year commitment to trauma-informed care, this investment marks the latest milestone in Kohl’s longstanding partnership with Boys & Girls Clubs of America. Since 2017, Kohl’s has donated over $21 million to support more than 4,700 local Clubs nationwide, helping Boys & Girls Clubs reach more than 4 million young people annually. In 2026, that support included[back-to-school shopping grants](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fcorporate.kohls.com%2Fnews%2Fstepping-out-with-confidence-helping-bgca-youth-own-their-next-chapter&esheet=54616614&newsitemid=20261009871668&lan=en-US&anchor=back-to-school+shopping+grants&index=3&md5=a6cda26df6afff97c9495d8dd1572730) ,[physical health and wellness grants for active play spaces](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fcorporate.kohls.com%2Fnews%2Fkohls-donates-1-million-to-create-active-play-and-wellness-spaces-at-boys-amp-girls-clubs-nationwidenbsp&esheet=54616614&newsitemid=20261009871668&lan=en-US&anchor=physical+health+and+wellness+grants+for+active+play+spaces&index=4&md5=d84ce39cdeed9d7f0dbaf923fe35dde8) , associate volunteering at local Clubs across the country, and continued sponsorship of the Boys & Girls Clubs of America Regional Youth of the Year events, which celebrate exceptional youth leaders nationwide.


Funding for the partnership is made possible through Kohl’s Cares® Goods for Good™ merchandise collections, which donate 100% of net profit to nonprofits supporting family health and wellness initiatives nationwide.


To join Kohl’s in supporting the Boys & Girls Clubs of America and make a difference for youth across the country, visit[bgca.org](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.bgca.org%2F%3Fform%3DDonateSEM%26recurring%3Dmonthly%26utm_source%3Dgoogle%26utm_medium%3Dsem%26utm_campaign%3Didm_evrg%26utm_content%3Dsld_dr_evrg_br_srch_br-monthly%26gad_source%3D1%26gad_campaignid%3D10336039864%26gbraid%3D0AAAAADs1h8veCCTecWQos8K3GjnftkhZD%26gclid%3DCj0KCQjwzY7VBhDwARIsAFtPvBTXum9o3BjD4EOWN-A7NseqCN5W2JfAwg6fF5R8CvPGNIyic0HqU_0aAiDyEALw_wcB&esheet=54616614&newsitemid=20261009871668&lan=en-US&anchor=bgca.org&index=5&md5=d9876f78106654f4af5cb79aaba19d03) .


**About Kohl’s**


Kohl’s (NYSE: KSS) is a leading omnichannel retailer built on a foundation that combines great brands, incredible value and convenience for our customers. Kohl’s is uniquely positioned to deliver against its long-term strategy and its purpose to take care of families’ realest moments. Kohl's serves millions of families in its more than 1,100 stores in 49 states, online at Kohls.com, and through the Kohl's App. With a large national footprint, Kohl’s is committed to making a positive impact in the communities it serves. For a list of store locations or to shop online, visit Kohls.com. For more information about Kohl’s impact in the community or how to join our winning team, visit[Corporate.Kohls.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=http%3A%2F%2Fcorporate.kohls.com&esheet=54616614&newsitemid=20261009871668&lan=en-US&anchor=Corporate.Kohls.com&index=6&md5=d423908ed6ea8b36e322a06fc270dba0) .


**About Boys & Girls Clubs of America**


For more than 160 years, Boys & Girls Clubs of America ([BGCA.org](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=http%3A%2F%2Fbgca.org&esheet=54616614&newsitemid=20261009871668&lan=en-US&anchor=BGCA.org&index=7&md5=a3981f9c8b45e7019e70aa038bce6fee) ) has provided a safe place for kids and teens to learn and grow. Clubs offer caring adult mentors, fun and friendship, and high-impact youth development programs on a daily basis during critical non-school hours. Boys & Girls Clubs programming promotes academic success, good character and leadership, and healthy lifestyles. Nearly 5,500 Clubs serve more than 4 million young people through Club membership and community outreach. Clubs are located in cities, towns, public housing and on Native lands throughout the country, and serve military families in BGCA-affiliated Youth Centers on U.S. military installations worldwide. The national headquarters is located in Atlanta. Learn more about Boys & Girls Clubs of America on[Facebook](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.facebook.com%2Fbgca.clubs%2F&esheet=54616614&newsitemid=20261009871668&lan=en-US&anchor=Facebook&index=8&md5=c6635d51723da1804554b458fb533cb4) and[LinkedIn](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.linkedin.com%2Fcompany%2Fbgcaclubs&esheet=54616614&newsitemid=20261009871668&lan=en-US&anchor=LinkedIn&index=9&md5=1318f14f44cfbe2a00d5619961709d00)[.](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.linkedin.com%2Fcompany%2Fbgcaclubs&esheet=54616614&newsitemid=20261009871668&lan=en-US&anchor=.&index=10&md5=fc60e76eb989bd9e1ffee595b3264911)
